C0332.title: Man Sentenced in Zhaoqing for Reselling WeChat Accounts
C0332.summary: The Dinghu Court in Zhaoqing tried a case where defendant Su purchased large quantities of personal information such as citizen ID numbers, names, and phone cards online. He used this data to register real-name verified WeChat accounts, 'raised' them by logging in for 8 to 15 days, and then sold the verified accounts for profit.
